coach_lose_next.text: That one was tricky. Next time!

coach_notbest_clear.text: Board cleared. A little slower than your best. You know you have more in you.

coach_notbest_close.text: Nice finish. Not a new best this time, but the next one could be.

old_aside_cat.text: The cat's on the board again. Mentally. She's very judgmental.

old_aside_heat.text: Who turned the heat up in here?

old_aside_humming.text: Is that my radio? No? Then who's humming?

old_aside_knees.text: My knees just predicted rain. They're never wrong.

old_aside_pigeons.text: The pigeons out back are plotting something. I can feel it.

old_aside_remote.text: Where'd I put the remote? Don't you move, I'm still talking.

old_aside_smell.text: I smell something funny. Was that you?

old_aside_socks.text: One sock's missing. I blame the squares.

old_aside_stove.text: Hold on, I think I left the stove on.

old_aside_tea.text: My tea's gone cold again. Story of my life.

old_aside_tuesday.text: Is it Tuesday? Feels like a Tuesday.

old_good_accident.text: A correct buddy. I'll assume it was an accident.

old_good_clap.text: Don't expect me to clap. My hands are cold.

old_good_clock.text: Even a broken clock is right twice a day.

old_good_day.text: Back in my day that would've been a Tuesday. Still, not terrible.

old_good_fine.text: Fine. That one was fine. Don't get excited.

old_good_grumble.text: Hmm. Adequate. That's the nicest word I've got.

old_good_knees.text: My knees approve. High praise, from them.

old_good_lucky.text: Lucky tap. Don't let it go to your head.

old_good_once.text: You got one right. Write it down, it might not happen again.

old_good_square.text: That square can stay. The rest of them are still nervous.

old_good_surprised.text: Well, would you look at that. I'm surprised too.

old_good_tea.text: Not bad. I'll allow a sip of tea.

old_hint_cane.text: Lean on that hint. I lean on a cane. We all need something.

old_hint_cheating.text: Back in my day we called that cheating.

old_hint_flashlight.text: A hint? Want a map and a flashlight too?

old_hint_grandkid.text: My grandkid asks for hints. He's four.

old_hint_push.text: A hint, huh. Fine. Every legend needs a little push.

old_hint_smart.text: Asking for help already? Smart. Sad, but smart.

old_hint_stare.text: A hint? In my day we just stared at it until it gave up.

old_hint_tell.text: Go on, take the hint. I won't tell anyone. I'll tell everyone.

old_idle_beard.text: I grew a beard waiting for that. Look at it.

old_idle_birthday.text: Hurry up. I'd like to finish before my birthday.

old_idle_crossword.text: I started a crossword while I wait. It's going better.

old_idle_glacier.text: I've seen glaciers with more hustle.

old_idle_gossip.text: Still thinking? The squares are starting to gossip.

old_idle_kettle.text: Should I put the kettle on? Feels like a two-kettle puzzle.

old_idle_mail.text: The mail came faster than your next move.

old_idle_nap.text: Wake me up when you've got a move. I'll be snoozing.

old_idle_twenty.text: Take your time. I've got maybe twenty years left.

old_idle_younger.text: Any day now. I'm not getting any younger.

old_jab_backday.text: Back in my day we didn't tap. We committed.

old_jab_bingo.text: I've seen better moves at a bingo hall.

old_jab_buddy.text: That buddy looks as confused as you do.

old_jab_map.text: You need a map for a five-by-five? Bless your heart.

old_jab_mitts.text: You play like you're wearing oven mitts.

old_jab_patience.text: I've got patience. You've got... something else.

old_jab_phone.text: Is this your first time holding a phone?

old_jab_shoes.text: Tie your shoes and try that square again.

old_jab_square.text: Pick a square, any square. Preferably a different one.

old_jab_thinking.text: I can hear you thinking. It's very quiet.

old_lose_called.text: Called it. I called it at the first square.

old_lose_goldfish.text: Game over. Even my goldfish saw that coming.

old_lose_nephew.text: My nephew lost like that once. He's a lawyer now. Worked out fine.

old_lose_popcorn.text: And that's the ballgame. Rematch? I'll get my popcorn.

old_lose_sandwich.text: Hearts gone. Go have a sandwich and think about what you did.

old_lose_sideways.text: Well, that went sideways. Dust yourself off, kiddo.

old_lose_tape.text: Out of hearts. I'd lend you one, but mine runs on duct tape.

old_nearmiss.text: Almost. Almost doesn't win a medal.

old_notbest_calendar.text: Nice clear. Your best time is over there, waving. From far away.

old_notbest_downhill.text: A win, but slower than your record. It's all downhill from here, kid.

old_notbest_ghost.text: Done, sure. Your ghost finished first and went home.

old_notbest_knees.text: Cleared it. Slower than before, and I know slow. Ask my knees.

old_notbest_rerun.text: Same board, slower time. Like a rerun, but longer.

old_notbest_slowpoke.text: Board's done. Your record's safe. From you, mostly.

old_notbest_tea.text: You won. I finished a whole cup of tea. Last time I only got a sip.

old_notbest_tsk.text: Board's clear... but slower than last time. Tsk.

old_notbest_yesterday.text: You won. Your old self still beat you, though. He's smug about it.

old_record_head.text: New record, huh. Don't let it go to your head.

old_record_tea.text: Faster than last time. I nearly spilled my tea.

old_rescue_cat.text: Rescued! Like a cat from a tree. A very confused cat.

old_rescue_coins.text: Coins well spent. That buddy was a disaster.

old_rescue_lifeguard.text: Somebody call a lifeguard. You're drowning in squares.

old_rescue_modern.text: Buying your way out of trouble? Very modern.

old_rescue_parachute.text: Nice parachute. Shame about the landing.

old_rescue_refund.text: Rescue, huh. Nothing says confidence like a refund.

old_undo_aging.text: Pick one! I'm aging over here.

old_undo_dizzy.text: Make up your mind! The board's getting dizzy.

old_undo_eraser.text: You'd wear out an eraser in a day.

old_undo_face.text: Undo all you like. You can't undo that face you're making.

old_undo_hokey.text: Undo, redo, undo. You're doing the hokey pokey.

old_undo_regret.text: So much regret for one little square.

old_undo_rocking.text: Back and forth, back and forth. Are you solving, or rocking in a chair?

old_undo_vacation.text: That undo button's gonna need a vacation.

old_undo_yoyo.text: Up, down, back, forth. You're a yo-yo.

old_win_eventually.text: You won. Eventually. I'll allow it.

old_win_frame.text: Frame it. It might not happen again.

old_win_gaveup.text: Well, look at that. The board gave up before you did.

old_win_paint.text: That was like watching paint dry. But with a happy ending.

old_win_squirrel.text: A blindfolded squirrel would've been quicker. But fine, you won.

old_win_twothree.text: Messy. Slow. Victorious. I'll take one out of three.

old_win_ugly.text: A win's a win. Even an ugly one.

old_win_yesterday.text: Done already? Oh wait, you started yesterday. Nice.

old_wrong_again.text: Ha! Classic. Do it again, I missed it.

old_wrong_bold.text: Bold. Wrong, but bold. Mostly wrong.

old_wrong_chaos.text: Oh sure, put it there. Why not. Chaos is free.

old_wrong_choice.text: That's a choice. Not a good one, but a choice.

old_wrong_close.text: Close. Well, no. Not close at all, actually.

old_wrong_hallway.text: You'd get lost in a hallway, wouldn't you?

old_wrong_history.text: That move's going in the history books. Under 'don't'.

old_wrong_knees.text: My knees make better decisions than that. And they're sixty years old.

old_wrong_loudly.text: I'm not saying it's wrong. The board is saying it's wrong. Loudly.

old_wrong_love.text: Nope. And I say that with all the love I have left.

old_wrong_money.text: You tapped that like it owed you money.

old_wrong_nickel.text: In my day a wrong move cost you a nickel. You'd be broke by now.

old_wrong_personal.text: Did the board do something to you? That felt personal.

old_wrong_pigeon.text: Even a pigeon would've skipped that square. A pigeon!

old_wrong_spectacles.text: Put your glasses on. Oh, you don't wear any? There's your problem.

old_wrong_stick.text: Back in my day we solved these with a stick. And we were faster.

old_wrong_tea.text: Wrong. I'd explain why, but my tea's getting cold.

old_wrong_teacher.text: Somewhere, a puzzle teacher just felt a chill.

old_wrong_toaster.text: I've seen a toaster make smarter choices.

roman_almost.text: Roman says: so close… and yet so Roman.

roman_badge_fridge.text: Roman says: badge unlocked. Put it on the fridge!

roman_badge_impressed.text: Roman says: badge get! Roman is impressed.

roman_badge_shiny.text: Roman says: new badge! So shiny!

roman_badge_wear.text: Roman says: ooh, a badge. Can I wear it?

roman_banana.text: Roman says: banana split victory. You did it!

roman_bonk.text: Roman says: bonk. Try a different square.

roman_booger.text: Roman says: booger face, champion heart!

roman_boss.text: Roman says: I am the puzzle boss.

roman_brain.text: Roman's brain: big. Your move: bigger.

roman_brainfart.text: Roman says: tiny brain fart. You're fine.

roman_broccoli.text: Roman says: broccoli power. You cleared that board!

roman_bubblegum.text: Roman says: bubblegum pop. Sticky sweet win!

roman_cantwin.text: Roman says: well, you can't win them all.

roman_cheer.text: Roman says: yes! Keep that energy!

roman_cheese.text: Roman says: extra cheese on that win. Delicious!

roman_close.text: Personal space! Even buddies need it.

roman_clutch.text: Roman says: clutch! That was clean!

roman_cocky.text: Roman says: don't get cocky. I'm still watching.

roman_colorblind.text: Roman says: are you color blind? That color's taken!

roman_cook.text: Roman says: you cooked that board!

roman_critter.text: Roman says: you caught the spark critter!

roman_cuddle.text: Roman says: no cuddling — even corners count!

roman_daily_done.text: Roman says: daily challenge, done! See you tomorrow.

roman_dance.text: Roman says: I'm doing a tiny victory dance with my eyebrows.

roman_dino.text: Roman says: I was thinking about dinosaurs the whole time.

roman_eyeballs.text: Roman says: I beat that with my eyeballs closed. Mostly.

roman_forgot.text: Roman says: wait — what were we talking about?

roman_fridge.text: Roman says: I was talking to the fridge. It gets me.

roman_ghost.text: Roman says: boo! Just kidding. You won!

roman_hearts.text: Roman says: hearts down, spirit up. Rematch!

roman_helicopter.text: Roman says: helicopter hair. We are taking off!

roman_highfive.text: Roman says: high five, puzzle champ!

roman_highfiveself.text: Roman says: high five to myself. You can watch.

roman_highhopes.text: Roman says: I had high hopes for you. Bummer.

roman_hint_clue.text: Roman says: tiny clue. Big brain.

roman_hint_psst.text: Roman says: psst. Look over there.

roman_hint_secret.text: Roman says: I didn't tell you this, but try that square.

roman_hint_spy.text: Roman says: my spy eyes see a clue.

roman_hint_treasure.text: Roman says: X marks the spot. Well, kinda.

roman_hint_wink.text: Roman says: wink wink. That square.

roman_idle_admire.text: Roman says: I am admiring this empty square.

roman_idle_blink.text: Roman says: blink twice if you are still there.

roman_idle_hello.text: Roman says: hello? The board is getting lonely.

roman_idle_loading.text: Roman says: still loading your next move.

roman_idle_sandwich.text: Roman says: I could eat a sandwich while I wait.

roman_idle_snore.text: Roman says: zzz. Wake me when you tap.

roman_idle_sphinx.text: Roman says: the sphinx is less patient than me.

roman_itchy.text: Roman says: my butt is itchy. Anyway — you won!

roman_juice.text: Roman says: victory! Also — juice box, please.

roman_lizard.text: Roman says: a tiny lizard just clapped for you!

roman_lose_cape.text: Roman says: capes off. Try again!

roman_lose_fought.text: Roman says: that board fought back. Rematch?

roman_lose_nap.text: Roman says: out of hearts. Even legends need a nap.

roman_lose_pillow.text: Roman says: I'm screaming into a pillow. Rematch?

roman_lose_round.text: Roman says: the board wins this round. Not the war.

roman_lose_shake.text: Roman says: shake it off, puzzle pal. Next round!

roman_lose_snacks.text: Roman says: hearts empty, snack bowl full. Try again!

roman_moonwalk.text: Roman says: moonwalk across the board. Smooth!

roman_myboard.text: Roman says: nice try. Still my board though.

roman_nap.text: Roman says: nap time. You earned it. I earned it more.

roman_nearmiss.text: Roman says: so close! Roman felt that one.

roman_nope.text: Roman says: nope-a-dope. Not that one.

roman_notbest_again.text: Roman says: winner! Not your fastest. Roman noticed. Roman always notices.

roman_notbest_record.text: Roman says: board cleared! Your record just yawned, though.

roman_notbest_turtle.text: Roman says: you did it, turtle-style! Your best time says hi.

roman_nudge.text: Roman says: trust the empty square.

roman_nugget.text: Roman says: this win smells like chicken nuggets.

roman_okayfine.text: Roman says: okay fine. That one was pretty good.

roman_oops.text: Whoops! That was a spicy miss.

roman_pants.text: Roman says: I put on my fancy pants for this win!

roman_pickle.text: Roman says: pickle me proud. That was crisp!

roman_plotwin.text: Roman says: plot twist — you actually did it!

roman_potato.text: Roman says: potato. That's the whole comment.

roman_practice.text: Roman says: practice more — then challenge me.

roman_proud.text: Roman says: I'm proud of that move!

roman_raccoon.text: Roman says: a raccoon stole my strategy. Still won vibes.

roman_record_beat.text: Roman says: you just beat your own best. Show-off!

roman_record_best.text: Roman says: new record! Somebody write that down!

roman_record_faster.text: Roman says: faster than ever. I've got goosebumps!

roman_retry.text: Roman says: plot twist — try again!

roman_rowmate.text: Roman says: that row already has a roommate!

roman_samecolor.text: Roman says: same color club is full!

roman_sandwich.text: Roman says: did anyone see where I left my sandwich?

roman_shoe.text: Roman says: hang on — I lost a shoe under the couch.

roman_shrug.text: Roman says: shrug. Magic. Next board.

roman_silly.text: Roman says: silly goose move. Shake it off!

roman_skillissue.text: Roman says: skill issue. Shake it off!

roman_sleeping.text: Roman says: did you fall asleep mid-tap?

roman_sneeze.text: Roman says: achoo! You still won though.

roman_sock.text: Roman says: who took my other sock?

roman_spaghetti.text: Roman says: there's spaghetti on the ceiling. Not sorry.

roman_spin_lucky.text: Roman says: lucky spin! Roman approves.

roman_spin_ooh.text: Roman says: ooh! What did you get?

roman_spin_spoken.text: Roman says: the wheel has spoken!

roman_stash.text: Roman says: critter stash complete! Big bonus!

roman_stash_jazz.text: Roman says: critter stash! Roman is doing jazz hands.

roman_stash_party.text: Roman says: five sparks! Sparkle party!

roman_stillbetter.text: Roman says: you did great — but I'm still better.

roman_taco.text: Roman says: cool cool. Now where are the tacos?

roman_toes.text: Roman says: my toes are freezing. Celebrate harder.

roman_trial_clear.text: Roman says: you survived Roman's Trial! Double coins!

roman_trumpet.text: Roman says: toot toot! Victory trumpet!

roman_trying.text: Roman says: are you even trying?

roman_underpants.text: Roman says: superhero underpants. Cape not included!

roman_unicorn.text: Roman says: unicorn sparkles. That move was magic!

roman_victoryburp.text: Roman says: quiet victory burp. Excuse Roman.

roman_warmup.text: Roman says: that was your warm-up, right?

roman_win.text: Roman wins! Confetti in my hair!

roman_worm.text: Roman says: even the worm is doing a happy wiggle!

roman_wrong_bold.text: Roman says: bold move. Wrong square.

roman_wrong_complaint.text: Roman says: I filed a tiny complaint about that tap.

roman_wrong_drama.text: Roman says: the drama. The miss. The heart.

roman_wrong_grandma.text: Roman says: even my grandma would skip that square.

roman_wrong_oof.text: Roman says: oof. That one bounced off.

roman_wrong_politely.text: Roman says: politely, that spot is a no.

roman_wrong_trophy.text: Roman says: no trophy for that square.

roman_wrong_wifi.text: Roman says: that move has no signal.

spark_1.text: One sparkle so far. Four more for the bonus!

spark_2.text: Two sparkles. Three more for the bonus!

spark_3.text: Three sparkles. Two more for the bonus!

spark_4.text: Four sparkles. Just one more for the bonus!

spark_have_1.text: You've got one sparkle toward the bonus.

spark_have_2.text: You've got two sparkles toward the bonus.

spark_have_3.text: You've got three sparkles toward the bonus.

spark_have_4.text: You've got four sparkles. So close!

tip_daily_coach_careful.text: Daily Challenge! Only one try counts, so take your time.

tip_daily_coach_streak.text: Come back every day to build your streak and earn more coins.

tip_daily_old_glasses.text: Daily puzzle. I do one every day too. It's called finding my glasses.

tip_daily_old_parking.text: One shot, kiddo. No do-overs. Like parking at the grocery store.

tip_daily_roman_first.text: Roman says: it's the Daily Challenge. Everybody gets this board today. Only your first try counts.

tip_daily_roman_streak.text: Roman says: win today, win tomorrow, and your streak grows. Like Roman's ego.

tip_stall_coach_combo.text: Quick moves keep your combo alive. Even a little X counts!

tip_stall_coach_fewest.text: Try the row or region with the fewest open squares first.

tip_stall_coach_marks.text: Stuck? Mark the squares that can't have a buddy. It opens things up.

tip_stall_old_combo.text: Your combo died of old age. And I'd know about old age.

tip_stall_old_free.text: Put an X somewhere. X's are free. Unlike my patience.

tip_stall_old_timer.text: The timer doesn't stop for thinking, kiddo. Neither do I. Well, I do. Often.

tip_stall_roman_beg.text: Roman says: tap something. Anything. Roman is begging politely.

tip_stall_roman_clock.text: Roman says: the clock is still running. Roman checked. Twice.

tip_stall_roman_combo.text: Roman says: every second you think, your combo takes a nap.

tip_star_coach_card.text: Tap the level card to see what you need for three stars.

tip_star_coach_score.text: For three stars you need a high score too. Keep the combo going with quick, clean moves.

tip_star_coach_time.text: So close to three stars! Beat the target time on the start screen.

tip_star_coach_undo.text: Three stars means zero undos. Plan your moves, then tap.

tip_star_old_barber.text: The third star doesn't like undos. Neither does my barber.

tip_star_old_coffee.text: Score's too low for the third star. Try moving like you've had coffee.

tip_star_old_motel.text: Two stars. Like a motel. Go get the third.

tip_star_old_time.text: You finished. So did the ice age. Faster next time for the third star.

tip_star_roman_combo.text: Roman says: faster moves build a combo. Combo builds score. Score builds Roman's respect.

tip_star_roman_recipe.text: Roman says: no undos, fast time, big score. That's the three-star recipe. Roman wrote it.

tip_star_roman_time.text: Roman says: two stars? Cute. Beat the target time and bring me three.

tip_star_roman_trial.text: Roman says: three stars unlocks Roman's Trial. Roman's waiting. Roman is always waiting.

tip_stuck_coach_hint.text: Feeling stuck? The Hint button lights up a safe square.

tip_stuck_coach_learn.text: Try a hint. It's not cheating, it's learning!

tip_stuck_coach_region.text: Look for a region that fits in one row. Its buddy has to go there.

tip_stuck_old_complaint.text: You've been staring so long the squares filed a complaint. Try the hint.

tip_stuck_old_knees.text: Hint button. Bottom of the screen. I'd press it for you, but my knees.

tip_stuck_roman_1987.text: Roman says: even Roman uses a hint sometimes. Once. In 1987.

tip_stuck_roman_row.text: Roman says: stuck? Look for a row with only one spot left.

tip_stuck_roman_shiny.text: Roman says: the hint button is right there. It's shiny. Press it.

tip_trial_coach_marks.text: Tip: X's are free, and they never cost a heart. Use them.

tip_trial_coach_rules.text: This is the Trial: race the clock, two hearts, no undo. You've got this!

tip_trial_old_doctor.text: Two hearts and a timer. I've had doctor's appointments like this.

tip_trial_old_life.text: No undo button in here. Welcome to how life works.

tip_trial_roman_coins.text: Roman says: beat the clock and you get double coins. Lose, and Roman laughs. Gently.

tip_trial_roman_welcome.text: Roman says: welcome to Roman's Trial. Two hearts, no undo, and a clock. Roman is not sorry.

tip_undo_coach_cost.text: Heads up: each undo costs 25 points and resets your combo.

tip_undo_coach_marks.text: Try marking X's first. They're safer than guessing a buddy.

tip_undo_coach_stars.text: Want three stars? Finish without any undos. Take a breath before you tap.

tip_undo_old_crying.text: Back in my day we had one undo. It was called crying.

tip_undo_old_prices.text: Twenty-five points a pop. At these prices I'd think before I tapped.

tip_undo_old_rent.text: Undo again and I'm charging you rent on that button.

tip_undo_roman_count.text: Roman says: every undo costs twenty-five points. Roman is counting. Roman is always counting.

tip_undo_roman_rules.text: Roman says: three undos? No three stars for you. Roman's rules.

tip_undo_roman_sock.text: Roman says: undo, undo, undo. Your score is shrinking like a wool sock.
